S27.01.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact from a chat reply
S27.01.note: The card falls back to Untitled but the viewer falls back to Artifact, so the defaults differ.
steps: Sign in and open a chat that has a Document artifact (ask the assistant to write a document if none exists).
Look at the Document artifact card in the chat and note its title.
Click the card to open the viewer and read the title at the top.
Click the title and look for the Rename action (tooltip text) to change it.
Clear the title and compare: the card should show the default word Untitled and the viewer should show the default word Artifact.
S27.01.where: Chat > open a Document artifact card > read the title at the top of the viewer; click the title to rename it

S27.03.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact from a chat reply
S27.03.note: Source editing is offered only on the latest version and not for PDF, Word or image artifacts.
steps: Open a Document artifact from a chat reply (it must be the latest version).
Click the Source icon in the viewer header, or open the More menu and click Edit source.
Change some text in the Markdown source.
Click Save (Save artifact source) to save it.
Look for a new version in the version stepper and check that the text you typed is shown.
S27.03.where: Chat > open a Document artifact > Source (header icon) or More > Edit source, type, then Save

S27.06.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact from a chat reply
S27.06.note: The toolbar has no Underline button; it has Strikethrough instead. Documents with math, footnotes or raw HTML open as plain Markdown instead.
steps: Open a Document that the rich editor can keep (it opens in the formatting view, not the plain Markdown view).
Select some words and click Bold, then Italic.
Select words, click Link, type a web address and confirm.
Click the Link text and check the address it opens.
Compare what you see with the Expected: bold, italic and link should show on the text.
S27.06.where: Chat > open a Document artifact > Edit source or Formatting toolbar > Bold, Italic, Link

S27.07.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact from a chat reply
steps: Open a Document artifact in the formatting view.
Click the Bulleted list button and type two lines.
Click the Numbered list button on a new line.
Click the Checklist button on a new line and type an item.
Look at the result: three kinds of list should appear and the checklist should show a checkbox.
S27.07.where: Chat > open a Document artifact > Formatting toolbar > Bulleted list, Numbered list, Checklist

S27.08.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact from a chat reply
steps: Open a Document artifact in the formatting view.
Click the Insert table button.
Type text into the table cells and press Tab to move between cells.
Look at the table: it should show rows and columns that can be edited.
S27.08.where: Chat > open a Document artifact > Formatting toolbar > Insert table

S27.09.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact from a chat reply
S27.09.note: Searched the artifacts folder for Insert image, Add image, Upload image and Insert: no image button exists in the document toolbar. Images render from Markdown, and the only image-replacement path found is for design artifacts (replaceImage in ArtifactPreview.tsx).

S27.11.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact from a chat reply
S27.11.note: The toolbar has no equation button; math is entered as text in the Markdown source, and math documents open as Markdown.
steps: Open a Document artifact in the formatting view.
Click the Code block button and type some code.
Open Source (or Edit source) and type a math line between dollar signs, for example a formula.
Go back to the Preview and check that the code block shows as code and the formula renders as an equation.
S27.11.where: Chat > open a Document artifact > Formatting toolbar > Code block; equations are typed in the Markdown source

S27.12.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact with 3 or more headings
S27.12.note: The Outline appears only when the document has at least 3 headings (OUTLINE_MIN_HEADINGS = 3).
steps: Open a Document artifact that has at least three headings, in Preview.
Click Outline to open the list of headings.
Click a heading in the list.
Check that the document scrolls to that section.
S27.12.where: Chat > open a Document artifact in Preview > Outline (click to open) > click a heading

labels.text: Checklist changes save as a new version when you pause.

S27.27.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact from a chat reply
S27.27.note: No saving or saved indicator was found. Source edits save only when Save is clicked, and checklist ticks save as a new version about 4 seconds after you pause.
steps: Open a Document artifact and start editing it (Source, or Edit source).
Type a few words and pause.
Look at the header for the status text (Draft kept on this device or Draft not kept) and the Save button.
Click Save and check that the status text and the new version appear.
Compare with Expected: there should be a saving and a saved indicator.
S27.27.where: Chat > open a Document artifact > Edit source or Formatting view; watch the Save button and the status text

S27.28.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact with at least two saved versions
S27.28.note: The More menu Undo and Redo appear only in the panel view and only when there is more than one version.
steps: Open a Document artifact that has at least two versions (edit and save once more).
Open More and click Undo; check that the text goes back to the previous version.
Open More again and click Redo; check that the newer text returns.
In the formatting view, type text, then click Undo and Redo in the Formatting toolbar.
Compare with Expected: undo and redo should move through the changes.
S27.28.where: Chat > open a Document artifact > More > Undo / Redo; in the formatting view, Formatting toolbar > Undo / Redo

S27.29.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact with at least two versions
steps: Open a Document artifact that has at least two versions.
Click the Version history button in the header.
Read the list: each entry shows Version N and its time.
Click Restore on an earlier version and confirm the Restore dialog.
Check that the earlier text is shown and a new version was added.
S27.29.where: Chat > open a Document artifact > Version history (clock icon in the header) > Restore

S27.35.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact from a chat reply
S27.35.note: This item appears only for Document artifacts, not for PDF or Word artifacts.
steps: Open a Document artifact in the viewer.
Click the Download artifact button in the header.
Click Download as Word (.docx).
Open the downloaded file in Word or Pages.
Compare with Expected: a Word document with the same text should open.
S27.35.where: Chat > open a Document artifact > Download artifact > Download as Word (.docx)

S27.36.needs: a signed-in account and a Document artifact from a chat reply
S27.36.note: The same label also appears for presentations; this item uses the Document path.
steps: Open a Document artifact in the viewer.
Click the Download artifact button in the header.
Click Download as PDF.
Open the downloaded file in a PDF viewer.
Compare with Expected: a PDF with the document text should open.
S27.36.where: Chat > open a Document artifact > Download artifact > Download as PDF

S27.37.needs: a signed-in account and an artifact from a chat reply
steps: Open a Document artifact in the viewer.
Click the Download artifact button in the header.
Click Download as Markdown.
Open the downloaded .md file in a text editor.
Compare with Expected: the file should contain the document as Markdown text.
S27.37.where: Chat > open an artifact > Download artifact > Download as Markdown
